descriptionEn: Create a wall of Ice Crystals which holds back enemies. The Crystals explode if sufficiently damaged, or if pushed hard enough, damaging nearby enemies. Consumes a Lightning Infusion if possible to add another Lightning explosion if destroyed.
summaryPt: Parede de cristais de gelo. Os cristais explodem quando quebrados — os clones do Hollow Form quebram e causam dano no chefe.
